    • getCoordinateOfNode

      public static javafx.geometry.Point2D getCoordinateOfNode​(BoardNode node)
      Gives the coordinate of a given node on the game-board. The coordinate lies within [0,1] x [0,1] and denotes the centre of the node at the Board-image used in-game (this means it will not be affected by any changes done to the board-image after BoardGraphics)
      Parameters:
      node - a boardnode
      Returns:
      a Point2D object representing the node's coordinate (centre of the node) invariant: x and y must lie in the range [0,1]

    • getScreenPositionOfNode

      public java.awt.Point getScreenPositionOfNode​(BoardNode node)
      This result may change in real-time if the screen or board is resized
      Parameters:
      node - a node
      Returns:
      a Point storing the x and y screen positions of the *origin* of the given node

    • getNodeAtCoordinate

      public BoardNode getNodeAtCoordinate​(javafx.geometry.Point2D coord, double node_radius)
      Gives the node that the given point is inside of (no guarantees are given when it is inside multiple nodes), based on the radius of the node given in board-image percentages (same way as the coord).
      Parameters:
      coord - the [0,1]x[0,1] position of the point to be checked, where 0 denotes the most left or most top of the board-image and 1 denotes the most right or most bottom of the board-image.
      node_radius - the radius of the nodes in percentages of the board-image (so in [0,1])
      Returns:
      null if the coordinate is not inside any node, a node that contains the given point if its radius is the given radius otherwise

    • getNodeAtScreenPosition

      public BoardNode getNodeAtScreenPosition​(java.awt.Point screenpos, double node_radius, java.awt.Insets insets)
      Parameters:
      screenpos - The position on the screen to check (in pixel points)
      node_radius - The radius of the nodes (in the scale of pixels, but allowing in between values by double)
      insets - the insets of the screen of which the screenpos is being measured, also includes any offset of drawing the board anywhere else than (0,0)
      Returns:
      null if the coordinate is not inside any node, a node that contains the given point if its radius is the given radius otherwise

    • updateNodeCoordsFromPixelMap

      public static void updateNodeCoordsFromPixelMap​(java.awt.Image board_image, java.awt.image.BufferedImage pixelmap)
      Parameters:
      board_image - the board image this pixelmap relates to
      pixelmap - an image with the same size of the board image containing pixels of alpha 0 or r+g+b==0 for all pixels but a few. The non-empty pixels are the centre positions of the nodes in the board (goes untill the 121st pixel and no further)
